title: Adult training course (canonical entity file)
description: One file per adult training course: data/training/<slug>.json. Scouting America publishes these as a chart of course codes (Y01, S11, WS10) against the positions that require them, in TRAINED LEADER REQUIREMENTS; nothing machine-readable exists. This entity carries only the course's own identity. WHICH POSITION NEEDS IT IS NOT HERE: the same course is required by different positions in different unit types, and the same position code means different courses in different unit types (CC needs C60 in a pack and WS10 in a troop), so that edge lives in data/training-requirements/. Note these are ADULT registered-position courses; the youth positions in data/positions/ are a different catalog with a different purpose (earned toward a rank, not trained for a registration).

code.description: Scouting America's course code as printed (Y01, S11, WS10, D16). Null for the online position-specific paths, which the chart names but does not code.

name.description: Course name as printed in the chart. Abbreviations are the source's own ('Intro to Outdoor Leadership Skills', 'C. S. Den Ldr. & Asst. Pos. Spec. Tng').

delivery.description: How the course is taken. `unknown` is the honest default: the chart states delivery only for Youth Protection and via two footnote markers, so most courses genuinely do not say. Per-position delivery notes live on the requirement, not here, because the markers are attached to cells rather than to courses.

renew_months.description: How often the course must be retaken, in months. Set ONLY where the source states an expiry - Youth Protection Training at 24 months. Null means the source states no expiry, NOT that none exists.

modules.description: Ordered named parts, where the chart lists them (the online paths run Before the First Meeting -> First 30 Days -> Position Trained). Completing the course means completing all of them.
